verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is an API-first product with an extensively documented public HTTP API: an HTML API with many parameters, dedicated search, ecommerce, AI and usage endpoints, an llms.txt index, a Postman collection, and path-versioned v1 with a documented deprecation of query-string API keys. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), no changelog or formal deprecation-policy page, and no independent hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
